## Problem

What log injection, terminal escape, secret redaction or structured logging problem is not handled well today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the exact input, output, error behavior and default. Explain why the default remains fail closed.

## Compatibility impact

Would this change existing valid output, error codes, type declarations or performance bounds?

## Alternatives considered

What application-level workaround exists today?

## Scope check

Is this within CWE-117 neutralization, terminal escape sanitization, credential redaction, structured record sanitization or single-line NDJSON output? If not, explain why it belongs in this zero-dependency package.
